C1711.title: Merchant Sentenced for Defrauding Government-Issued Consumer Vouchers
C1711.summary: In 2023, Xu, the legal representative of a swimming pool in Shenzhen, colluded with external parties during a government consumer voucher campaign. They fabricated transactions and used bank collection QR codes to falsely redeem vouchers. Xu retained 20%–25% of the voucher value as a kickback and returned the remainder to the collaborators, defrauding public and private property on an exceptionall
